Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+233F, which you can use as ⌿ in HTML, \233F in CSS, or type with Alt+9023 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+233F is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⌿ or the hex escape ⌿.

How to type apl functional symbol slash bar on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 0 2 3 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9023.
  4. Release Alt. The Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar character (⌿) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type apl functional symbol slash bar on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar" and click the character to insert it.

How to use apl functional symbol slash bar in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\233F"; ()
  • Python: \u233F or chr(0x233F)
  • JavaScript: \u233F or String.fromCodePoint(0x233F)
  • JSON: "\u233F"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⌿?

No legacy Alt code exists for Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+233F in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⌿ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⌿, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9023 not work?

Alt+9023 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar?

The Unicode codepoint for Apl Functional Symbol Slash Bar is U+233F. You can use this value in HTML as ⌿, in CSS as \233F, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⌿ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+233F, then click it.
